about: CHAT_PLAN Phase 10 handoff_1010: 25 questions, each asked with its one note under the six model failures of tests/test_chat_degrades.py (150 turns, fake transport). The composed sentence is the note's; the model's unsupported answer names 2019 and Lisbon, which no note holds. A measured question ("how far did I run") is the app's own sum and never asks the model, so none is here.
